bands.label: Excellent awareness and detailed knowledge of musical features of topic.
guidance: Excellent reference to all ten musical excerpts on the accompanying audio recording which illustrate the feature(s) discussed.
Excellent research evident, with excellent personal response.
Excellent sources and reference to pieces of music/composer/performer.

bands.label: Very good awareness and detailed knowledge of musical features of topic.
guidance: Very good reference to all ten musical excerpts on the accompanying audio recording which illustrate the feature(s) discussed.
Very well researched, with very good personal response.
Very good sources and reference to pieces of music/composer/performer.

bands.label: Good knowledge of musical features of chosen topic, but lacking in detail.
guidance: Good reference to all/some of the musical excerpts on the accompanying audio recording which broadly illustrate the feature(s) discussed.
Good research in evidence with good personal response.
Good sources and good reference to pieces of music/composer/performer.

bands.label: Some general points on topic, but lacking in detail.
guidance: Choice of topic too broad to allow for appropriate detailed and personal response.
Some reference to all/some of the musical features of topic and to musical recordings.
Recorded excerpts do not illustrate / relate to the features in the essay.
General sources used, but lacking specific focus.
Some reference to pieces of music/composer/performer.

bands.label: Generally inadequate response to chosen topic.
guidance: Little or no evidence of research or personal response.
Little or no reference to musical features of topic
Little or no reference to musical recordings.
Inadequate sources listed  and inadequate reference to pieces of music/composer/performer.

bands.label: Very little response to chosen topic in evidence.
No response to chosen topic in evidence.

asks.notes: Lead ask of the shared card: the scheme gives element 1 ("Name of topic") "-" and marks elements 2-4 together on one 0-100 band ("Paper 2-4"); the card's 100 marks sit here. Descriptors refer to "all ten musical excerpts"; the paper never says ten (Q3 asks for five pieces). Scheme spacing kept: "Inadequate sources listed  and". The stem keeps the printed capitals ("ALL").

asks.questionText: List THREE of the sources which you used in studying this topic. Full details are required for all of your sources. If one of your sources is the internet, give the full website address used in your research.
asks.notes: Marked inside the shared 0-100 band (elements 2-4). (i)-(iii) are answer slots, not asks. "THREE" is printed in capitals (the text layer stores it lower case); "internet" is lower case in print this year.

asks.questionText: Name FIVE pieces of music, and the composer or performer, which you studied as part of this listening elective, and which are on your audio recording.
asks.notes: Marked inside the shared band. The Piece / Composer or Performer table (rows 1.-5.) is an answer slot. "FIVE" is printed in capitals.

asks.questionText: Identify THREE significant musical features of your chosen topic.
asks.label: 4. (a)
asks.notes: Marked inside the shared band. Printed "4.(a)"; "musical" is italic and "THREE" in capitals in print. (i)-(iii) are answer slots.

asks.questionText: Give an account of your chosen topic ensuring that you • describe the three musical features which you have identified above • show how your three chosen, and other, musical features are present in the music you have studied for this elective • make reference to all the musical excerpts on your recording • include your personal response to your chosen topic.
asks.label: (b)
asks.notes: Marked inside the shared band. Answer space runs on pages 3-6; page 7 is staves for rough work.
